about_the_game:
Get ready to crank up the volume with the Galaxy Highways soundtrack, a high-energy blend of hard rock guitars and retro-inspired synths. The music was crafted to match the fast-paced, arcade-style action of the game while channeling the spirit of classic space shooters and 90s nostalgia.

The entire soundtrack was composed and produced by Roman Mocnar, the game's lead developer, designer, and writer. As both a musician and the creator of Galaxy Highways, he set out to create music that pulses with intensity, blending hard rock riffs with synthwave melodies that capture the retro-futuristic soul of the game.

"Creating the music for Galaxy Highways was a true joy. As someone who loves hard rock guitar and plays the piano, I enjoyed every moment of crafting each riff and layering the synths to make them all click together. I hope this soundtrack brings you as much enjoyment as I had making it."

— Roman Mocnar
